name: Jai Mata Glass Limited
about: Jai Mata Glass Limited trades in glass in India. The company offers K-series, patterned, elegant frosted, and wired glasses. It also acts as a sales agent in the eastern and northern regions of India. The company was formerly known as Jai Mata Rolled Glass Ltd. Jai Mata Glass Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
